scope: Hodram's first Stockholm trading-post tutorial (SC1 block 136)
profile_note: Fixed-allocation companion layer to the existing Hodram opening probe; only already-mapped SC1 presentation states are retained.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.context: Hodram and Charles review captured cargo and the trading controls at Stockholm's trading post.
records.source_meaning: Hodram asks Charles how the captured goods turned out.
records.localization_note: Natural American localization from the clean Japanese; source line breaks are layout evidence and are not copied.

records.english: {SPEAKER:12}Quite well. We're selling it now. Any orders?{PAD}
records.speaker: Charles
records.context: Hodram and Charles review captured cargo and the trading controls at Stockholm's trading post.
records.source_meaning: Charles says the haul was good, that it is being sold, and asks for instructions.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.context: The player chooses whether to proceed with selling the captured goods at Stockholm's trading post.
records.source_meaning: Hodram agrees to direct the sale.
records.localization_note: A natural affirmative that exactly fills the choice record's ten-byte allocation.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.context: The player chooses whether to proceed with selling the captured goods at Stockholm's trading post.
records.source_meaning: Hodram orders Charles not to sell the captured goods.

records.english: {SPEAKER:FE}Choose Trade, then select the goods to buy or sell.{PAD}
records.speaker: Tutorial narration
records.context: Hodram and Charles review captured cargo and the trading controls at Stockholm's trading post.
records.source_meaning: The tutorial says to choose Trade and then select the trade goods to purchase or sell.

records.english: {SPEAKER:FE}Buy only when cargo space is free. With a full hold, sell goods first to make room.{PAD}
records.speaker: Tutorial narration
records.context: Hodram and Charles review captured cargo and the trading controls at Stockholm's trading post.
records.source_meaning: The tutorial says goods can be bought only with an empty cargo hold and instructs the player to sell cargo first when necessary.

records.english: {SPEAKER:FE}To sell, use the D-pad to choose goods, then press A.{PAD}
records.speaker: Tutorial narration
records.context: Hodram and Charles review captured cargo and the trading controls at Stockholm's trading post.
records.source_meaning: The tutorial explains how to select goods for sale with the directional pad and confirm with A.

records.english: {SPEAKER:FE}To buy, pick a local specialty and press A. The selected goods go into the hold.{PAD}
records.speaker: Tutorial narration
records.context: Hodram and Charles review captured cargo and the trading controls at Stockholm's trading post.
records.source_meaning: The tutorial explains how to select a local specialty to buy and confirms that it enters the cargo hold.

records.english: {SPEAKER:FE}Choose goods for every ship, then press X: Done to finish trading.{PAD}

records.context: Hodram and Charles review captured cargo and the trading controls at Stockholm's trading post.
records.source_meaning: The tutorial says to press X Done after selecting every ship's purchases and sales, completing the transaction.
